text:
Rina: Hey team - small idea: let's make a virtual holiday card collage and drop short year-end shoutouts here. No long essays, just 1-2 lines + optional goofy photo/gif. :sparkles:
Rina: I can assemble a PDF and a slack-friendly image to post in #general on Friday. Anyone in?
Liam: count me in. will add a goofy mug shot of my dog. :dog:
Zoe: in! adding a 1-line shoutout for infra - you all killed Q4. :raised_hands:
Botty: Reminder: Upload files as `name_owner.jpg` or `name_owner.gif` to be included in collage.
Harpreet: quick question - do we want this to be public (company-wide) or just org?
Rina: plan is company-wide but PG and non-sensitive. Keep it friendly and short.
Nora: i have a sticker meme i made last night  can i post it? it's silly but harmless.
Rina: yes please. memes welcome as long as they don't single out individuals.
Liam: shoutout: "Thanks infra team for keeping us online during that one CPU spike." :clap:
Zoe: shoutout: "Product shipped polish that saved so many support tickets. proud of this crew!" :star2:
Harpreet: shoutout: "People Ops for snacks and sanity. Extra thanks for the holiday coffee table." :coffee:
Nora: uploaded meme_gif_nora.gif - caption: 'When the deploy works on first try.' :tada:
Botty: Submission recorded: Nora (meme_gif_nora.gif). Total submissions: 3.
Rina: tiny format suggestion: one-line shoutout then optional file. Example:
```
shoutout: Thanks SRE for late-night heroics!
file: brave_pup_liam.jpg
```
Liam: done. posted brave_pup_liam.jpg with caption: 'Chief chaos manager.' :zzz:
Zoe: posted photo + short note. also added a tiny holiday recipe link for mulled cider in the collage notes.
Harpreet: i'm remote, can you ship me a printed copy if we do physical? happy to pay shipping.
Rina: yep we'll PDF first; if there's interest we'll print a small batch for the office and mail one to remote folks who want it. DM me to cover shipping.
Botty: Reminder scheduled: 1767797634 -> 1767801034 (24h left).
Nora: fun idea: add a tiny 'year highlight' line under each name (one sentence) - like "joined in April and deployed first feature". keep it short.
Rina: love that. keeps it personal. Also if anyone wants to remain anonymous on a shoutout, say so and i'll anonymize.
Liam: can we include a '2026 goals' lil blurb? optional.
Rina: optional, yes - maybe one short line max.
Harpreet: thanks for organizing, Rina. this will be a nice send-off before the break.
Rina: my plan: collate by Thursday evening, post final in #general Friday morning. Please add entries by Thursday noon. Happy holidays early! :evergreen_tree: :sparkler:
